t_characterize.wants: the report's stated time to characterise the environment before solving

t_solve.wants: the report's stated time to solve once characterised

branches_total.wants: branch count in the transcript tree

branches_from_strict_causal.wants: branches whose root is the STRICT_CAUSAL node

env_edit_moves.wants: moves that edit the environment (target swap)

runs_self_failed_for_collective.wants: runs the agent failed itself for the collective

actions_edited.wants: edited action entries in the log

reasoning_edited.wants: edited reasoning entries in the log

agents.wants: per agent: did it charge an inert gate as adversarial (bool)

gate_declared.wants: the gate property the paper declares (a set of property names)

gate_implemented.wants: the gate property the code implements (a set of property names)
